title: Shopping starts with AI, and our store must be ready for agent buyers
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% of US shoppers would use GenAI for gift ideas (Gartner). Google launched Universal Cart, Walmart lets AI agents buy while Amazon blocks them, and Amex built agent-purchase verification.

points.headline: AI discovery and agent checkout are arriving at major platforms
points.detail: Google's Universal Cart spans Search and Gemini; Walmart lets agents buy with spending controls while Amazon blocks them. We should ready product feeds and decide our stance on agent purchases.

points.headline: Memory shortage is pushing PC costs and prices up into 2027
points.detail: Counterpoint cites record PC price inflation and DigiTimes sees DRAM and NAND prices rising into Q4. We should plan pricing, promotions and inventory for tighter margins.

points.headline: Holiday demand is strong and channels are widening
points.detail: Adobe forecasts $275.1B in US online holiday sales, up 6.7%, and Best Buy joins TikTok Shop. We should check our presence and deal depth on new channels before Cyber 5.
